svg.text: CED Module 6 (Pahl & Beitz, 2007) — built from the SNPS, overall I/O and the 22-item Requirements List
the user's use-process, step by step
Input: untreated water, unknown MP content → Output: water confirmed free of/reduced in MPs + a reading + captured MPs safely contained
(battery or mains — form-factor dependent, see Requirements List)
LEVEL 2 DETAIL — the three solution-determining sub-functions
Open scope question — flagged, not yet resolved:
Requirement 6.4 (≥99.99% bacteria/virus/protozoa removal) implies a disinfection sub-function inside SEPARATE — but Presentation 1 (slide 22)
scoped “purification” (coagulation + disinfection) as the existing RO/UV system's job, not this device's. Team should confirm before ideation.
